description: Search valid decision nodes for a stack depth, tagged by depth (1 = RFI, 2 = vs open, 3 = 3-bet pots, …). Compact mode is paginated; use depth, contains, and offset to narrow results without loading thousands of paths. plo9 has no spot index: walk it with get_node from history "UTG".

detail.description: Response detail. "compact" is the default and removes bulk maps; use "full" only when exact complete data is required.

game.description: "nl" = no-limit hold'em 6-max cash (169-grid hands, per-hand EV in small blinds), "nl9" = no-limit hold'em 9-max cash, "nlmtt8" = no-limit hold'em 8-max MTT chip-EV (10–300bb, 1bb BB-ante; Fold/Call/Limp/AI/Open/3B tokens), "nlh8-hydra" = no-limit hold'em 8-max MTT chip-EV with a classic 0.1bb ante from every seat (10, 20, 30, 60bb; same tokens as nlmtt8), "plo" = pot-limit Omaha 6-max cash (4-card), "plo5" = pot-limit Omaha 5-card 6-max (100bb, 1.2bb ante), "plo9" = pot-limit Omaha 9-max cash, "plo6hu" = 6-card Omaha heads-up (BTN vs BB, 100bb). Cash trees are not tournament, ICM, PKO, or satellite solves. nlmtt8 is chip-EV only.

limit.description: Maximum compact rows to return (default 120, maximum 500).

name: list_spots

outputSchema.description: Valid decision nodes for one game and stack, paginated.

hint.description: How to narrow, page, or widen the same query.

matched.description: Spots left after the depth and contains filters.

nextOffset.description: Offset for the next page, or null at the end.

depth.description: Decision depth: 1 = RFI, 2 = vs open, 3 = 3-bet pots.

history.description: Action path ending in the acting position.

total.description: Spots in the dataset for this stack.

title: Search preflop spots
